about_the_game:
Additional graphical content with futanaris: girls with both a penis and a vagina, often also with testicles.

  • 5 card sets (solo, on a sex machine, with a girl, with another futa, group)

  • 52 backgrounds

  • 260 card backs (use the same images as card sets)

  • 104 pictures to use in UI pop-ups and similar

  • 260 images are available for custom minigames. Make sure to set field tiling to roughly match the image proportions, to avoid cropping important detail (face, dicks, pussy).

Note: some backgrounds may be too colorful for some card sets. The new "bg color overlay" slider and a color picker in Options->Graphics will let you adjust backgrounds the way that feels best for you.

Images were AI-generated, with a lot of my manual sketches involved in the iterations.

Images are 2048 pixels in the bigger dimension. You could use them e.g. as wallpapers on your smartphone, laptop or other device. In Steam Library, select NSFW Solitaire, press "gear" button (Manage), Manage, Browse local files. This will open the game's folder in the file browser. Open DLC_Futa/Pictures. There in subfolders are 260 pictures. Those ending with  _v ("vertical") should be fine for a phone. Those ending with _h ("horizontal") are best as laptop/desktop backgrounds.
